Hardened point resolution, profile reads and boundary mutations against multiple ACTIVE versions within one entity history; added regression tests for fail-closed assignment and independent repair.

Added strict MultiPolygon component topology validation: reject touching/intersecting components and overlapping filled interiors; preserve valid island-in-hole cases.
Added regression tests for overlapping/touching MultiPolygon components and valid disjoint/island-in-hole components.
Added a dedicated branch-scoped GIS GitHub Actions workflow for npm run test:geospatial and TypeScript typecheck.

Hardened geospatial snapshot validation across every boundary history: reject malformed history/record shapes, map-key/entity mismatches, duplicate record IDs, duplicate or out-of-order versions, and multiple ACTIVE versions; added durable-recovery regression coverage.
Updated boundary bbox overlap diagnostics to exclude entity histories with multiple ACTIVE versions rather than arbitrarily selecting the first; added regression coverage.

Added durable snapshot validation for canonical geometry, simplified geometry and exact persisted bounding-box consistency; added malformed geometry, malformed simplified geometry and stale bbox regression cases.

Audited valuation and spatial market summary consumers: valuation now requires an explicit valid boundary version ID/version; market summary returns null boundary metadata instead of synthesizing version 1 when no unique ACTIVE boundary exists.
Hardened sub-neighborhood assignment: a point on a micro-neighborhood edge does not inherit its sub-neighborhood ID, and any matched active boundary edge prevents an interior valuation result.
Fixed a point-resolution integrity gap: a parent-neighborhood interior no longer masks a matched sub-neighborhood boundary edge; edge matches do not emit a sub-neighborhood ID.
Added a regression proving a point on a sub-neighborhood edge is marked RESOLVED_ON_EDGE and rejected by valuation feature generation.
Fixed bbox overlap diagnostics to require exactly one ACTIVE record across the complete entity history before filtering by city or boundary level; added a mixed-metadata duplicate-ACTIVE regression.

Added an injectable canonical ValuationLocationResolver contract to the valuation module; coordinate-bearing estimates fail closed when the resolver is absent or its canonical city/neighborhood differs from the request.

Added valuation regression coverage for missing resolver, successful coordinate resolution, and mismatched neighborhood identity; added test:valuation-location and included it in the GIS focused workflow.

Audited production API composition: apps/api/server.ts mounts the GIS router but does not construct or mount createValuationService/createValuationRouter; documented that production valuation API integration remains unresolved.

Re-audited the current branch IRNI RPC v2 consumer: the Worker Service Binding and revision/checksum-verified identity facade exist, but the v2 entity DTO does not provide authoritative polygon geometry.
Confirmed the Worker neighborhood-boundary endpoint generates explicitly approximate visualization hexagons and is not a valid valuation boundary source.
Confirmed Express GIS point resolution reads its boundary-history snapshot repository; no verified IRNI geometry ingestion path was established.

Confirmed valuation production composition remains incomplete: apps/api/server.ts does not mount the valuation router, and no production ValuationDataConsumerAdapter or IRNI-backed ValuationLocationResolver was established.
Expanded GIS blocker documentation with the exact IRNI geometry, production composition, and API integration acceptance gates.
Queried GitHub Actions Jobs API for GIS, IRNI RPC and Worker bundle failures; all four jobs report runner_id=0, empty runner_name and zero steps, confirming no workflow step was recorded.

Expanded the GIS workflow push and pull_request path filters to cover all changed valuation, property-search, persistence, IRNI identity and marketplace regression paths; added those focused test files to the regression command.
Expanded Browser UX workflow source watches to include the changed Neighborhood Inspector and NIPS profile UI files; verified both workflow files by GitHub read-back.
